sources.title: ninfer-5080/model-cards/Qwen3.8-27B-NInfer at master - GitHub
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B for NInfer This model card is the version-controlled source for neroued/Qwen3.8-27B-NInfer. The repository contains Qwen3.8-27B converted to the native NInfer.ninfer artifact format. The artifact is intended only for NInfer; it is not a Transformers checkpoint, Safetensors distribution, or GGUF file.
